_doc_stage_size: Xplor extends FlxGame and calls super(320, 240, LogoState, 2) — the final arg is zoom, so the actual rendered stage is 320*2 x 240*2.
_doc_classes: Kitty's state lives on instance fields of the live Player inside PlayState, not on class statics. The classes block only gates readState / onEnterFrame until xplor.PlayState is loaded — actual path reads and writes use getDefinitionByName inside the bridge path walker, not the registered aliases.
_doc_path_reads: player_x and player_y are instance-field reads through the runtime object graph: FlxG.state -> defaultGroup -> first Player in members -> x/y. In this version of Flixel (used by Kitty) FlxState extends Sprite, not FlxGroup — children live in FlxState.defaultGroup, a public FlxGroup field, whose members array holds the added sprites. The filter step uses getQualifiedClassName normalized to dot form.
_doc_teleport: Kitty has no level concept — the entire game is one tilemap owned by a single PlayState. Teleport is two path writes into the live Player's x and y fields. Pixel coords come from tile coords via px = tile * 16, matching Player's constructor which does startx = param1 * 16. pre_invocations fire only when the adapter hasn't yet seen a successful path read (i.e. still on the LogoState title screen) — they construct a fresh xplor.PlayState and assign it to FlxG.state, which synchronously runs PlayState.create() and spawns the Player, so the following path writes land on a live instance.

pre_invocations._doc: LogoState adds its intro logoBitmap directly to FlxG._game via addChild, outside the _buffer that holds the active FlxState. switchState() only clears _buffer, so the logoBitmap would linger on screen after we force-transition to PlayState. Strip the topmost child from _game — LogoState's logoBitmap is always the most-recently-added child because the Flixel engine is done initializing by the time LogoState.create() runs, so it's at the highest index. remove_last_child avoids hardcoding an index that would break if the engine adds more debug children on some setups.

_doc_location_coords: Pixel coordinates for the Location dropdown teleport. Save points listed first in gameplay discovery order, then collectibles. Teleports directly onto the tile (pixel = tile * 16).
